C1405.title: Tornado Cash Governance Attack via Contract Metamorphism
C1405.summary: A Smart Contract Hacking guide highlights the Tornado Cash governance attack as a classic case, where the attacker used contract metamorphism to take over the protocol, demonstrating an attack pattern where controlling protocol governance enables fund theft.

references.title: DAO Governance Attacks: Beanstalk, Tornado Cash & Voting Exploits (2026)
